In addition, look out for the Denim Tears SSP parallel, and newly added Captains, Celebracion case hit inserts. Autograph collectors can chase a robust lineup of Topps Chrome Autographs, including special appearances from Druski and Spike Lee. The 1980-81 Topps Basketball Autographs deliver another loaded checklist, while the ultra-cool Lava Lamp Rookie Autographs add a groovy twist.
